diff --git a/tests/unit/components/test_blockutils.py b/tests/unit/components/test_blockutils.py

@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@ import typing
 import os
 import io

+from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject, QUrl
 
 import pytest
 
@@ -53,11 +53,44 @@ def test_blocklist_dl(pretend_blocklists):
 
     list_qurls = [QUrl(l) for l in pretend_blocklists[0]]
 
-    dl = blockutils.BlocklistDownloads(
-        list_qurls, on_single_download, on_all_downloaded
-    )
+    dl = blockutils.BlocklistDownloads(list_qurls)
+    dl.single_download_finished.connect(on_single_download)

     dl.initiate()
     while dl._in_progress:
         pass
 
     assert num_single == 10
+
+
+def test_empty_blocklist_emits_completion():
+    parent = QObject()
+    dl = blockutils.BlocklistDownloads([], parent=parent)
+    counts = []
+    files = []
+    dl.all_downloads_finished.connect(counts.append)
+    dl.single_download_finished.connect(files.append)
+
+    dl.initiate()
+
+    assert dl.parent() is parent
+    assert counts == [0]
+    assert files == []
+
+
+def test_multiple_download_listeners(tmpdir):
+    path = tmpdir / "blocklist"
+    path.write_binary(b"example.com\n")
+    dl = blockutils.BlocklistDownloads([QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(path))])
+    first = []
+    second = []
+    counts = []
+    dl.single_download_finished.connect(lambda fileobj: first.append(fileobj.read()))
+    dl.single_download_finished.connect(lambda fileobj: second.append(fileobj.name))
+    dl.all_downloads_finished.connect(counts.append)
+
+    dl.initiate()
+
+    assert first == [b"example.com\n"]
+    assert second == [str(path)]
+    assert counts == [1]
